clips.title: The story
paras: Dalaran's Intentions is a Silverpine Forest quest delivered by Dalar Dawnweaver to Shadow Priest Allister. Having studied a rune-inscribed pendant bound for the Kirin Tor in Ambermill, Dalar realizes the wizards intend to tap a dormant ley energy node beneath the town, prompting the Forsaken leadership at the Sepulcher to plan a counter-offensive.

While examining a rune-inscribed pendant recovered from a Dalaran supply crate, Dalar Dawnweaver remembers an old Kirin Tor survey. Ambermill was not chosen by the mages by coincidence; the quiet village rests directly atop a dormant ley energy node. Awaking such a subterranean nexus requires immense magical reserves, and the enchanted pendants worn by the wizards serve as key components in channeling and catalyzing that power.

The Forsaken cannot tolerate a fortified, power-fueled Kirin Tor outpost threatening the southern approaches to the Sepulcher and Tirisfal Glades. Whatever grand ritual the magi are preparing, harnessing raw ley lines would grant Dalaran an enormous strategic advantage in Lordaeron. Dalar sends word urgently to Shadow Priest Allister to formulate a strategy that will stall the wizards' progress before their ritual reaches completion.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Of course! How could I have forgotten?

Ambermill was one of the sites earmarked by the Kirin Tor, noted because it houses a dormant ley energy node. The wizards must be planning to reactivate the node and use its energies for some greater purpose.
We cannot allow this to happen...
It will take a great amount of power to activate the area's ley energies, we can stall them by taking the pendants away from the wizards.
Relay this information to Allister, he will decide a course of action.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ill news you bring, friend. If Dalar is correct--and I've no reason to believe he isn't--we must move quickly.
I must confer with him on our plan of attack. But in the meanwhile we will have to delay their progress.
